investor_summary: The supplied annual filing shows why total profit and continuing-business profit must be analysed separately. ITC also needs segment-sensitive valuation treatment; a completed company valuation is not available yet.

findings.title: Discontinued operations distort the profit comparison
findings.finding: The supplied annual statement reports FY2025 profit from discontinued operations of ₹15,016.01 crore. FY2026 shows none. Continuing-operations profit is ₹21,018.15 crore against ₹20,036.47 crore in FY2025.
findings.investor_use: A comparison of total profit across these years mixes different business scopes. Reconcile continuing earnings and segment economics before selecting valuation multiples.
